summary.value: In this submission, the authors proposed a novel multi-scale architecture for generalized dynamic system forecasting. Reviewers raised questions regarding the motivation/contribution of the submission, theoretical analysis, complexity of the model, as well as experimental evaluations, especially regarding the comparison of the recent work PANDA, and the authors agreed that the original version is overclaimed, and the novelty compared with PANDA is the multi-scale architecture.

reviewer_concerns.value: At the beginning, the writing of the manuscript is somewhat overambitious, which has been pointed out by different reviewers. Regarding the experimental analysis, the concerns regarding generalization is ok to the AC. However, the comparison regarding improvement, especially regarding PANDA, is not satisfactory. The authors rebuttal in a way by only using Wilcoxon signed-rank test, which can be limited. Moreover, the rebuttal of complexity issue and theoretical analysis is also not satisfactory. Regarding theoretical motivation, the authors responded in a way that the improvement comes from the use of MoE and multi-scale, but these two components are also quite common in many architectures.

reviewer_scores.value: Two reviewers who gave score of 4 and 2 are less likely to change their scores.
